summary: Frontend-only test of IOC Database feature on /threat-intelligence. Guest gating, admin gating, admin CRUD flows (single add / bulk paste / CSV upload / bulk delete / single delete) and IOC Analyzer 'Known IOC' severity banner integration all verified working. One caveat: the ioc-db-msg element was not captured after bulk/file/single-delete operations in some cases (likely cleared on tab switch or brief render), but underlying operations succeeded (verified via row counts and totals).

integration_issues.flow: IOC Database admin — bulk-paste / CSV upload / single-delete success message
integration_issues.issue: ioc-db-msg was not visible when queried ~3–4s after the action even though the operation succeeded (row totals confirmed 7 seeded + 1 single + 2 bulk + 2 CSV = 12 rows all deletable). Single-add and bulk-delete msgs were captured fine. Likely the message is being cleared when switching add-mode tabs or has a race with the state update. Consider persisting the message across tab switches or wrapping msg render outside the tab conditional.

action_items: IMPORTANT: The test wiped the IOC DB (bulk-delete removed all 12 IOCs including the 7 seeded ones, since row0 checkbox was select-all). E1 should re-run seed to restore the 7 baseline IOCs (including 185.220.101.4 Cobalt Strike C2 critical) required for the analyzer banner demo/tests.
Optional: ioc-db-msg is cleared on mode-tab switch — keep the last success message visible across tab switches for better UX and easier testing.

Optional: spec mentions setting severity during bulk-paste, but no [data-testid=ioc-bulk-severity] control exists in the UI; bulk items default their severity. Consider adding a severity selector to the bulk-paste form or update the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkbox with data-testid prefix 'ioc-db-select-' matches both per-row checkboxes and the select-all header checkbox — consider distinct testid (e.g., ioc-db-select-all) to prevent selector ambiguity in tests.
One 404 was logged in console (single resource, likely favicon/image); unrelated to feature but should be tracked.
test_credentials: admin@nivxmachines.com / NivX@Admin2025 (verified working; token stored in localStorage 'nivx_token')
seed_data_creation: None. Test WIPED existing seed data — E1 must re-run seed to restore baseline IOCs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IOC Database feature is functionally complete on the frontend. All key data-testids present. If retesting after re-seed, verify the seven baseline IOCs (esp. 185.220.101.4) come back and Known IOC banner still triggers. Consider using non-destructive test paths — do not click chks[0] because it is the select-all master. Use chks[1] and chks[2] for selecting individual rows.
